{{Top|leg}}
'''Hist''' was an expert shot with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. On at least two occasions, he gave lessons in marksmanship to [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Two of the hunters he taught, [[Tirog]]<ref name="Second Edition">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> and [[Thannik]],<ref name="Revised and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> spent a week honing their skills with Hist. By the end of each hunter's lessons, the students had equaled their instructor's skill.<ref name="Second Edition" /><ref name="Revised and Expanded" />
